title: SkillVerse : Assessing and Enhancing LLMs with Tree Evaluation

live_model.evidence: Fig.4: "Comparing the strengths and weaknesses of two proprietary models... GPT-4o vs GPT-4-turbo" on STEM tasks (58.7%-84.0% cells); scored from pre-existing {prompt,response} pairs.

prompt.note: Critiques use Gemini-1.5-Pro (occasionally GPT-4o) as judge; cites Lei-style prompting for other baselines, not reprinted.

claim.metric: none (Fig.4 scores historical ChatbotArena responses attributed to GPT-4-turbo, not a fresh call to the model)

data.source: ChatbotArena/IFEval logs (third-party, not redistributed by this paper)

notes: SkillVerse's dendrogram/critique framework is applied to GPT-4-turbo's pre-existing ChatbotArena battle transcripts (frozen historical data), not to fresh model calls; the live model that is actually queried by the authors is the Gemini-1.5-Pro/GPT-4o critique model (role A elsewhere in the paper).
